DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約のお問い合わせですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about your appointment, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。日本語だけでは難しく、通訳希望を追加したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通訳の追加を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Japanese alone is difficult for me, so I would like to add a request for an interpreter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to add interpreting support. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ベトナム語です。予約した相談内容は変わりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 言語と内容不変を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Vietnamese. The subject of my booked consultation is unchanged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the language and say the consultation subject is unchanged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対応の可否を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check whether we can arrange that.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人が来られるかも未定です。通訳確保済みとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 支援者未確定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not yet know whether my friend can come either. I will not say that an interpreter has been secured.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your support person is not confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日時の変更も必要なら案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: If a date or time change is necessary, we will explain that too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の予約を保ち、可能な言語支援の方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 既予約維持で方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to keep my current appointment and ask what language support is possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about support while keeping your existing appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 希望者はご本人ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You are the person requesting this, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。私の予約番号で、支援だけを追加してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人番号で支援を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Please use my appointment number and add only the support request.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request support under your own appointment number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本人の通訳希望として担当へ確認します。日時は案内前に変更しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check your own interpreter request with the person in charge. We will not change the date or time before explaining it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about your documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 郵送を頼んだと思いますが、控えに窓口受取とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 郵送希望と控えの相違を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I requested postal delivery, but my slip says counter collection.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the difference between your postal-delivery request and the slip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 控えの番号をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please give me the number on the slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。書類をもう一件申し込む前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同番号で重複を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I want to check before submitting another application for the documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the same number to avoid a duplicate application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 希望を受けた記録を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the record of your request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所だけ書いたことで郵送受付済みとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所記入と発送受付を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not assume that writing my address meant postal delivery had been accepted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish entering an address from acceptance of a delivery request. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ窓口の受取として記録されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is still recorded as counter collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では変更できるか、郵送費と本人確認の条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 方法変更の費用条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I would like to ask whether it can be changed, the postage and identity-verification requirements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about costs and conditions for changing the collection method. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が変更方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain how to change it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 変更結果を確認するまで、家族へ受け取りを頼まないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 結果前の代理受取を止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not ask my family to collect it until I have confirmed the outcome of the change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold off arranging collection by a representative before the result is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 同じ申込の受取方法変更として引き継ぎます。費用と結果を確認してから次の行動を決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass this on as a collection-method change for the same application. Check the costs and outcome before deciding what to do next.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: かばんは預けています。途中で出したカメラだけ見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: かばんと小物の不在を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My bag is in storage. Only the camera I took out along the way is missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish the stored bag from the missing smaller item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 取り出した場所はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where did you take it out?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 休憩所です。その後にかばんを預け直しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 取出しと再預けの経過を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the rest area. After that, I checked my bag back into storage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe taking the camera out and checking the bag in again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 預け先へ確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you checked with the storage location?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。かばん全体の紛失とは言わず、中に戻したか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物全体紛失とせず保管先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I will check whether I put it back inside, rather than report that the whole bag is lost.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check with the storage location without describing the whole bag as lost. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: カメラの特徴を教えてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 黒で赤いひもです。私物の写真があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 品の特徴を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is black with a red strap. I have a photo of my camera.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the item’s features. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 最後の確認と推測を分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will separate the last confirmed sighting from guesses.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 休憩所で撮影したのが最後です。預け先にあるとは断定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最後の使用と保管推測を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I last used it to take pictures at the rest area. I will not state that it must be at the storage location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the last use from guesses about its storage location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かばんの保管とカメラの最後の使用を分けて記録します。預け先確認も届け出に追加できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will record the bag’s storage separately from the camera’s last use. The storage-location check can also be added to your report.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 再配達のお手伝いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help arranging redelivery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電話の音声を聞き取りにくいので、文字の案内を希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 文字での手続きを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have trouble understanding the telephone guidance, so I would like written instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a text-based procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 不在票を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the delivery notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。音声の番号を何度も押して申し込んだとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 音声操作と受付を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I do not assume that pressing the voice-menu numbers repeatedly completed a request.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish voice-menu actions from acceptance of a request. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用できる方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will explain the available methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で入力した内容を確認してから送れる方法がよいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 送信前確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would prefer a method that lets me review what I entered before sending it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check your entries before sending. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受取希望の日時はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a preferred delivery date and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日の夕方です。候補として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日時候補を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Tomorrow evening. I am suggesting it as a possible time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give a proposed date and time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確定結果も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the confirmed result.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。希望を入力したことと確定の返事を分けて残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 希望と確定結果を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will keep my entered preference separate from the reply confirming it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish your request from the confirmed result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この不在票の文字案内をご覧ください。入力後に日時と受付結果を確認して進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please read the written instructions on this notice. After entering your request, check the date, time and acceptance result before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have lost your card, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。電話が切れて、停止の結果を聞けませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通話切断で結果未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The call disconnected, and I could not hear whether it had been suspended.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the call disconnected and the outcome is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どこまで伝えましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前だけです。カードを特定できたかも分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 伝えた情報範囲を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only my name. I do not even know whether the card was identified.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain how much information you provided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認しながら対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check as we handle this.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 途中で話しただけで停止済みとは決めず、改めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 停止済みとせず再相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask again instead of assuming it is suspended just because we spoke briefly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask again without assuming suspension is complete. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 午後二時です。折り返しを装う別の番号には情報を渡していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時刻と別連絡への未開示を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: At two in the afternoon. I have not given information to another number pretending to call me back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the time and say that you have not disclosed information to another contact. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本人の資料を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check your identification documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらです。対象と受付結果を自分で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人資料で対象結果を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here they are. I want to confirm the relevant card and the result of my request myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the relevant card and result using your own documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 対象カードを確認し、紛失対応を進めます。切れた電話と今回の受付結果を分けてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will identify the card and handle the loss. We will explain the disconnected call separately from the outcome of today’s request.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have the product with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家にあります。家族が捨てる前に相談したくて来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 廃棄前の相談を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is at home. I came to ask before my family throws it away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice before disposal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開封すると持ち手が外れました。使っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 不具合と未使用を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The handle came off when I opened the package. I have not used it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the problem and say the item is unused. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have a purchase record or photos?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。現物は捨てず残すよう家族へ頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記録を示し現物保持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will ask my family to keep the actual item without throwing it away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the records and keep the actual product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持参が必要か確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check whether you need to bring it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写真だけで交換確定とは考えず、必要な物を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真で交換とせず持参物を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please tell me what is needed; I will not assume photos alone guarantee an exchange.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what to bring without assuming photos confirm an exchange. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check its condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分で接着する前に、購入品の不具合として案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己接着前の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Before gluing it myself, I will ask for guidance about the defect in my purchase.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for a check before gluing it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 未使用、持ち手外れ、現物保管として引き継ぎます。持参方法は確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will report that it is unused, the handle came off and you are keeping the item. We will explain how to bring it after checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for somewhere to rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 荷物が重いですが、ベンチへ置いて散歩に行ってよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 荷物を置く案を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My luggage is heavy. May I leave it on the bench while I go for a walk?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about leaving your luggage behind. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 荷物を残さず管理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please keep your luggage with you and look after it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。荷物を持つので短い散歩にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 携行して短距離を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I will carry it, so I would like a short walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a short route while carrying your luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: How long would you like to walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十分以内です。先にここで休みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休憩後の時間条件を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: No more than ten minutes. I will rest here first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your time limit after resting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この道で広場を一周できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can go around the plaza on this path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その後、同じベンチへ戻らなくても駅へ出られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰路出口を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: After that, can I reach the station without returning to the same bench?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the exit for your return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 先の出口から駅へ行けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can reach the station through the exit ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では休んでから荷物を持ち、広場から駅へ帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物を持つ行程を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will rest, take my luggage and return to the station from the plaza.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose an itinerary that keeps your luggage with you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この短い道と駅側の出口をご利用ください。ベンチに荷物は残さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use this short path and the exit toward the station. Do not leave luggage on the bench.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to buy tickets?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 四人分を予約しました。一人来られず三人で使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 欠席による人数減を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I booked for four people. One cannot come, so three of us would like to use the booking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about reducing the number because someone cannot attend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ券を受け取りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you already collected the tickets?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、四人分があります。一人分だけ自分で破りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 四人券を改変せず示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I have tickets for four. I will not tear up one person’s ticket myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the four tickets without altering them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 券の条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the ticket conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三人の乗車を維持して、欠席分の扱いだけ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三人分の乗車維持を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to keep the travel arrangements for three and ask only how to handle the absent person’s portion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to preserve travel for the three remaining people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 人数変更の方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain how to change the number of travelers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返金できると決めず、手数料も聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返金条件と手数料を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask about fees too, without assuming a refund is possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about refund conditions and fees. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will you use the same service?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。変更後の券で三人分を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同便と変更後券を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check that the revised tickets cover three people.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the same service and check the revised tickets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: この便を三人で使う希望として係員へご案内します。四人分の券はそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will direct you to staff with your request for three people to use this service. Keep all four people’s tickets as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a notice, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私宛ての一件です。家族も来ましたが共同申請ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知本人の一件を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is one case addressed to me. My family came too, but this is not a joint application.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Make clear that this is one notice for you personally. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 件名を見せてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。家族は内容を聞く手伝いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族の補助役割を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. My family is helping me understand the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your family member’s supporting role. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同席の条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the conditions for their presence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 必要なら家族に外で待ってもらいます。本人の私が答えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人回答と別待機に応じる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: If necessary, I will ask my family to wait outside. I will answer as the person concerned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Agree to answer yourself and have your family wait separately if needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十日後です。まだ記入していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期限と未記入を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ten days from now. I have not filled it in yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the deadline and say it is unfilled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ未記入と伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the person in charge it is unfilled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 提出物と連絡先を私の通知番号で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知番号で提出条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would like to use my notice number to check what to submit and whom to contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about submission requirements using the notice number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 本人一件の通知として担当へ引き継ぎます。同席と回答方法は説明を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will refer this as a single notice concerning you. Please receive guidance about your family’s presence and how to respond.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察券はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have your patient card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありません。職場の健診は受けましたが、外来は初めてです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 健診歴と外来初診を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. I had a workplace health check, but this is my first outpatient visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish your health-check history from a first outpatient visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: What symptoms would you like to have examined?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日から腹痛があります。健診結果を聞くだけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今の症状と目的を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have had abdominal pain since yesterday. I am not here only to ask about health-check results.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your current symptoms and reason for visiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 健診の記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have the health-check records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 控えがあります。患者番号が同じか自分では分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 健診記録と番号未確認を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my copy. I do not know whether the patient number is the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the health-check record and say the number is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人の情報を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check your personal information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この資料です。健診の職場名を患者名とは記入しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人資料を正しく提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: These are my documents. I will not write the workplace name from the health check as the patient name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present your own documents correctly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 診療の受付方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain the registration procedure for care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 健診の控えと今の症状を分けて見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 記録と症状を別に引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please consider my health-check copy separately from my current symptoms.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the records separately from the symptoms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 外来の初受診希望として引き継ぎます。健診記録は別資料として受付へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-14210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will refer your request as a first outpatient visit. Please bring the health-check record to reception as a separate document.
